request.style: English, male soul voice, deep and resonant solo with backing choir, upright bass, Hammond organ, electric guitar, drums, cymbals, reverent and triumphant mood, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
So the work on the house of God in Jerusalem came to a halt
It stood still until the second year of the reign of Darius king of Persia
The eye of their God was on the elders of the Jews
They were not stopped until a report could go to Darius

[Chorus]
Let the house be rebuilt as a place for offering sacrifices
Let its foundations be laid with sixty cubits of height and width
The cost is to be paid from the royal treasury
I, Darius, have issued this decree

[Verse]
Then King Darius issued an order and a search was made
In the archives where the treasures were stored in Babylon
At Ecbatana in the fortress in Media a scroll was found
King Cyrus issued this order in his first year

[Chorus]
Let the house be rebuilt as a place for offering sacrifices
Let its foundations be laid with sixty cubits of height and width
The cost is to be paid from the royal treasury
I, Darius, have issued this decree

[Bridge]
Keep far away from there Tattenai and Shethar-bozenai
Leave the work on this house of God alone
Let the governor of the Jews and the elders rebuild this house
The cost is to be paid in full from the royal treasury

[Outro]
This house was completed on the third day of the month of Adar
In the sixth year of the reign of King Darius
